get.description: q searches names and descriptions. Several kind or tag_id values match any of them.
The starter modules (docs/mvp.md), and whether each is in the library yet.

post.description: Adds the starter parts that aren't in the library yet, unverified.

put.description:
The part's whole footprint, in mm from its origin: its body and each pin's hole.
Pins not listed get no hole.

get.description:
Holes laid out from the pins' sides: left and right pins as columns span_mm apart
(top and bottom as rows), pitch_mm between neighbours. Not saved.
Most recently changed first. Several tag_id values match any of them.
Every rule in docs/checks.md, errors first. Also part of every design answer.

delete.description: Removes the part and its wires.

post.description: Ends are `ref.PIN`, e.g. `esp.GPIO21`. All or none are added.

get.description:
Wires for the unwired pins of the part `ref`, to free pins of the board that suit
them: shared buses, a matching supply, GPIOs away from flash, strapping and
input-only pins. Read-only: send the ones wanted to add wires.

put.description: Sets all placements and wires at once: the canvas's undo and redo.

get.description: Newest first. Each holds the design as it was before the change in its summary.

post.description: Saves the current state as a revision first, so the restore can be undone.

get.description:
The design's pins for firmware: `pins.h` (lang=c) or `pins.py` (lang=py). With more
than one board in the design, `board` is its ref.

An Arduino sketch that checks the built circuit against the design, with the
pins.h it includes. With more than one board in the design, `board` is its ref.

platformio.ini for the board: its platform and board id, and the libraries the
design's parts need on that platform. With more than one board, `board` is its ref.

The design as Wokwi's diagram.json, with a wokwi.toml for the board's PlatformIO
build. Parts without a Wokwi type are left out with their wires, and listed.

post.description:
How a firmware's pins.h or pins.py differs from the design as it is now: constants
whose pin changed, newly wired ones, and ones no longer in the design. Read-only.

A stripboard is 24 strips of 37 holes unless sized; a breadboard pattern is 14 rows
(rails, two blocks of five, rails) of 62 holes unless sized.

put.description:
Puts design placements on the board (their footprint's origin at strip and hole),
moves them, or marks them off the board.

post.description:
Cuts the strips a part spans between pins that mustn't be joined (a module's two
header rows): at a free hole midway, or between holes when none is free.
Cuts each strip just past its outermost connection (between holes).

A generic connector named J1, J2… unless a ref is given; pins lists the off-board
pin each carries, `ref.PIN` or null.

put.description: Sets the whole layout at once: the board canvas's undo and redo.

get.description:
What to do at the bench: cuts (strip by strip, from the copper side), jumpers
with wire lengths, parts, connectors and cables, what to have ready, and the order
of work. Numbered as on the printed drawings.
Newest first: the layout as it was before the change in each summary.
The files of one part, oldest first.
Viewable types (PDFs, plain images) open in the browser; everything else downloads.

post.description: Replaces the token; clients using the old one stop working.

BodyMm.title: BodyMm
BodyMm.description: The outline a part covers on a board, in mm from its origin (top view).

BodyOut.title: BodyOut
BodyOut.description: The outline in board steps (fractional): strips and holes it spans.

BuildSheetOut.title: BuildSheetOut
BuildSheetOut.description:
What to do at the bench, in order. Cuts and jumpers are numbered as on the
printed drawings; cuts run strip by strip as seen from the copper side.

CanvasPart.title: CanvasPart
CanvasPart.description: What the canvas needs to draw a placed part.

ConnectorIn.title: ConnectorIn
ConnectorIn.description:
Pins are what each connector pin carries, in order: an off-board part's pin as
`ref.PIN`, or null for none.

ConnectorUpdate.title: ConnectorUpdate
ConnectorUpdate.description:
Only what's sent changes. strip and hole null take it off the board; pins is the
whole list.

DesignUpdate.title: DesignUpdate
DesignUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent are changed. shelf_project_id and firmware_repo are cleared
with null (firmware_repo with a blank too).

FirmwareFiles.title: FirmwareFiles
FirmwareFiles.description:
Generated files for one board: the bring-up sketch with its pins.h, or the
PlatformIO project file.

FootprintIn.title: FootprintIn
FootprintIn.description: A part's whole footprint: its pins not listed get no hole.

FootprintOut.title: FootprintOut
FootprintOut.description: A footprint made from the pins' sides, to check before saving.

Hole.title: Hole
Hole.description: A pin's hole in a footprint, in mm from the part's origin.

LinkOut.title: LinkOut
LinkOut.description: A connection the board doesn't make yet: the ratsnest.

NetOut.title: NetOut
NetOut.description: Pins joined by wires. Computed on every read, never stored.

PartLibrary.title: PartLibrary
PartLibrary.description: A library firmware for the part needs, on the platforms listed (empty: all).

PartPlace.title: PartPlace
PartPlace.description:
A design placement on the board (strip and hole of its footprint's origin), or
off it. The mount defaults to socketed for boards, soldered for everything else.

PartUpdate.title: PartUpdate
PartUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed. Nullable fields are cleared with null.

PinIn.title: PinIn
PinIn.description: A pin as sent by the pin editor. Its position comes from its place in the list.

PinMapCompare.title: PinMapCompare
PinMapCompare.description: A firmware's pins.h or pins.py, to compare with the design as it is now.

PinsReplace.title: PinsReplace
PinsReplace.description: The part's whole pin list, in order: each side's pins top to bottom or left to right.

PlacedRef.title: PlacedRef
PlacedRef.description: Where one of the design's placements is in a layout, for the schematic.

Platform.title: Platform
Platform.description: A board's PlatformIO platform; library entries can be limited to some of them.

SegmentOut.title: SegmentOut
SegmentOut.description: A straight run of joined copper and the design nets it carries.

Snapshot.title: Snapshot
Snapshot.description: A design's placements and wires: what a revision keeps, and what undo sends.

SuggestedWire.title: SuggestedWire
SuggestedWire.description: A proposed wire from the part's pin (a) to a board or supply pin (b).

SuggestedWiring.title: SuggestedWiring
SuggestedWiring.description:
Wires for a placed part's unwired pins. Nothing is added until they're sent to
add wires.

WokwiExport.title: WokwiExport
WokwiExport.description: diagram.json, and wokwi.toml when the board is known and simulatable.

WokwiSkipped.title: WokwiSkipped
WokwiSkipped.description: A placement left out of the Wokwi export: its part has no Wokwi type.
